description: This Java class defines a custom validator for password strength, implementing the ConstraintValidator interface and using the ZXCVBN library to evaluate password strength scores.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if a password meets specified strength requirements using ZXCVBN.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the password strength criteria from the annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the password based on its strength score compared to the required strength.
